text: Dream: write only falsifiable connection hypotheses
description: Write a connection hypothesis only when it could fail; otherwise leave it empty. On 2026-11-01, 333 hypotheses were untested and 7 reflected, and most read as classifications ("X is keyboard navigation behavior"). Smallest experiment: reflect the ~80 hypotheses on implemented children and count how many could have failed at all. Disconfirming: the reflection rate stays near 2% even with falsifiable hypotheses.
